chapter: Mamie Smith and the New York dance bands
title: Leaving Mamie Smith and the salary
summary: He left in February 1924, stayed in New York, and says they were paid well.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Well, how long did you stay with her.
Oh, I left her there in February, 1924. I stayed with up to '25, and that's, I started staying (unintelligible) in New York, went down and worked in the dance group.
Well, did you -- I mean did you make good money with her?
Yeah, we had a nice salary.
Yeah, I mean for that day.
For that -- we had -- we were played paid on weekends on the theaters.
